_description: Textarea component spec. Almost all tokens shared via component/-input/*. Unique tokens: resize handle icon (colour under icon/, dimensions under size/).

variables.name: component/textarea/icon/resize-default
variables.comment: Resize handle icon colour. 4-mode explicit (expanded from 2-mode 2026-07-04 per 4-mode-universal convention; Figma push pending). Foreground element — no hover variant, stays consistent across interaction states.

variables.name: component/textarea/size/resize-width
variables.comment: Resize handle icon width (12px). 4-mode explicit — Scania bound to scania/unit/12 (expanded from 2-mode 2026-07-04 per 4-mode-universal convention; Figma push pending).

variables.name: component/textarea/size/resize-height
variables.comment: Resize handle icon height (12px). 4-mode explicit — Scania bound to scania/unit/12 (expanded from 2-mode 2026-07-04 per 4-mode-universal convention; Figma push pending).

variables.name: component/textarea/icon/readonly-default
variables.comment: Readonly state indicator icon (Icon: Read only / Edit_inactive). Strong neutral — communicates 'not editable' without using validation colour. MIXED ROUTING: Scania verified via web component 2026-07-05 (textarea-vars.scss: grey-950 light / grey-100 dark = icon/strong); TRATON verified via canvas boundVariables 2026-08-05 (Textarea set 34279:126066, both brand-swap glyph vectors fill-bound to this token → color/icon/strong, both modes). Scoped to textarea; promote to -input if reused across dropdown/datepicker/etc.
